description: This Java source file defines the class PlaceholderFunctionSignatureInvalidException, a custom exception used in the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate invalid function signatures in placeholders. It includes methods for creating instances, JSON deserialization, and builder pattern implementation.

classes.name: PlaceholderFunctionSignatureInvalidException
